name: requirements-native-namespace
purpose: Observe an external member of a cross-pack family on the native route (requirements-native-namespace-k194). The sandbox home adds the marketplace of the prepared Grove checkout at the removal commit and installs requirements@linkuistics from it, which declares grove as a dependency. The Ravel settings have no skills key. A review-requirements leaf sits beside a retired requirements leaf and has a bare-name mandate. Expect the Skill tool to load requirements:grove-review-requirements, then the spine under the grove namespace, and a read of references/review.md from the spine's base directory, before the first action.
